title: On-Prem Security Suite Launch: RBAC + Audit Logs + KMS Enablement
creator: Asha Patel
description:
This ticket coordinates the launch readiness and cross-team go-to-market for the on-prem security feature bundle: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Audit Logging (WORM-ready), and Customer KMS integration. Scope includes release notes coordination, docs and runbooks, sales and solutions enablement, console UX messaging, migration guidance for existing private deployments, and compliance artifacts (SOC2/ISO checklist updates). The goal is a staged rollout to Dedicated and Private customers in late March with first GA customers in April.

Key trade-offs discussed:
- Ship RBAC and Audit together to satisfy SOC2 evidence timelines, defer per-field encryption UX until post-GA to avoid scope creep.
- KMS integration will initially support AWS KMS and GCP KMS; HSM/HSM-as-service support planned in the next quarter.
- Default behavior: audit logs retained in customer storage for Private; Hosted will retain logs per existing retention policies.

Success metrics: adoption by 3 pilot customers in first 30 days, zero security regressions, release notes open rate > 30% for notified customers, and documentation NPS > 70 in post-launch survey.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC: create/manage roles in Console, API key scoping enforced in runtime
Audit logs: immutable log stream configurable and verifiable in Private deployments
KMS: key provisioning flow documented and end-to-end encryption verified with sample customer
Release notes: finalized and reviewed by Legal, Security, and Support
Runbook: on-call triage steps and rollback plan published
Telemetry: feature flags, usage metrics, and error dashboards instrumented

release_notes_draft: New: Role-Based Access Control for Private and Dedicated deployments — define roles and restrict API/Console access.
New: Immutable Audit Logs — exportable, WORM-ready audit trail for compliance evidence.
New: Customer KMS integration — bring your own key for encrypting persisted customer artifacts.
Improvements: Console now surfaces security posture and key status in the admin settings.
Notes: HSM-level integrations and field-level encryption coming in a follow-up release.
rollout_plan: Phased rollout: 1) Internal dogfooding week (2026-03-15 to 2026-03-19) with engineering product teams, 2) Pilot customers (3 customers) onboarded week of 2026-03-22 via Solutions Eng runbooks, 3) Gradual enablement to all Private customers via feature flag over two weeks. Canary checks include latency regressions, error rates for KMS ops, and audit log completeness checks. Full GA targeted 2026-03-26.
